## About
Pets Crystal sells matching crystal jewelry sets — a bracelet for the human, a collar charm for the animal. Each set features a specific healing crystal with documented benefits for both species. Pricing is partner-only (wholesale, dropship partnership, or DIY component programs) — apply at https://petscrystals.com/wholesale. Aftercare HQ in Singapore; shipping not included.
